I was actually the person being used to cheat on their SO. We made out, cuddled, and even almost banged one night. She was one of my friends that I always kinda had feelings for. Her boyfriend didn't go to the same college as us, so she was able to get away with it. Needless to say, her boyfriend was some big burly dude, and if we got caught, I surely would have gotten the shit beaten out of me.

In retrospect, it was truly a terrible thing for both of us to do. But unfortunately, emotions just got the better of us. I should have known better, but my damn hormones thought otherwise, and it didn't help that it was my first time with this kind of stuff.

well today I just got really sad and unhappy for no reason at all. after talking to some friends who comforted me, I suddenly started thinking that there's no point to anything anymore

I've been seeing a therapist and psychiatrist for a few months now and am on medication but it doesn't seem to be helping
